name: DNA
full_name: De Nederlandse Alliantie (Groep Markuszower in parliament)

period.basis: Split from PVV in January 2026, founded as a party in April 2026. Inferred from the PVV record and the group's stated differences.

method: Hand-scored against the facet anchors in data/model.json. To be calibrated against CHES 2024 and voting advice tools.

notes.ECO: No programme yet; expected to be more market-friendly than PVV.
notes.MIG: Same core migration agenda as PVV.
notes.INT: Pro NATO and pro Israel; less hostile to the EU than PVV.
notes.CLI: Assumed close to PVV, slightly softer.
notes.DEM: Members' party, open to working with the cabinet; less anti-system than PVV.

sources.title: NOS: nieuwe partij De Nederlandse Alliantie
